page.notes: Doubtful readings: "florenos" (the word is blurred, marked [?]); the section number after "non diues ipsi" (printed as a long-s-like glyph, read as 5, marked [?]); "II." after "mortuus" (printed in capitals, copied as printed). A small mark above "ipse" in the line "cum ipse potius" is not a letter and is left out. Printed "haberet de gloriaretur" omits "quo" as printed. Printed "sedfolius" is run together as printed. Phil.2.13 and 1.Co.4.7 share one marginal note. Only the catchword and signature are at the foot. Running head and signature are checked against the scan; the signature is copied as printed.
